description: This file defines the BIFFwriter class used for generating BIFF (Binary Interchange and File Format) streams for Excel spreadsheet files, particularly handling low-level binary record writing, byte order management, and stream continuation handling within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: BIFFwriter
classes.description: A class responsible for writing BIFF binary records for Excel files, managing stream data, byte order detection, and record boundary splitting.

methods.name: getByteOrder
methods.description: Determines and returns the byte order (endianness) of the architecture.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends binary data to the internal BIFF data stream, managing record continuation if necessary.

methods.name: writeData
methods.description: Returns binary data to be written, handling record continuation logic.

methods.name: storeBof
methods.description: Writes the beginning of a BIFF stream (book or worksheet) record.

methods.name: storeEof
methods.description: Writes the end of a BIFF stream record.

methods.name: writeEof
methods.description: Returns the EOF record data for writing.

methods.name: addContinue
methods.description: Splits large BIFF records into contiguous CONTINUE blocks to adhere to Excel size limits.
